'''True Magick''' is a [[unique item]].  It first appeared in the [[Dunwich Horror]] expansion.

==Card info==
'''Type''': [[Tome]]

'''Movement''': Exhaust and spend 1 [[movement]] point to make a [[Lore check|Lore (-1) check]].  If you pass, gain 1 [[Clue token]] and lose 1 [[Sanity]].

'''Price''': $5

==Mythos Source==
True Magick first appeared in ''The Seventh Incantation'' (1973), written by Josef Payne Brennan.
